scripts.migrate: uv --directory api run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory api run fastapi dev src/main.py
scripts.check:api: uv --directory api run ruff format --check . && uv --directory api run ruff check .
scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir web check && pnpm --dir web typecheck
scripts.validate: pnpm run check:api && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run test:web && pnpm run build:web
